note: Combined's Legacy mapping (window 2015..2016) carries a steward data_warning on 2016 only (#1684); the base catalog carries one register-wide warning. A period straddling the warning's start returns both; a period before it returns only the base warning. Fails if extend-db's holdings compile drops the mapping warning, writes it at the table edition or the mapping window instead of its own window, attributes it to a cell readers do not hold, or loses or rewrites the base's warnings when it merges the two.
